title: Mechanisms
description: Biological mechanisms through which foods and bioactive compounds may influence body systems, used by the Personal Wellness Blueprint recommendation engine.

category.description: Editorial sub-domain grouping (e.g. 'Lipid Metabolism', 'Gut Health'). Not read by engine code; for authoring organisation only.

description.description: A genuine, mechanism-specific scientific explanation. Must not be a templated restatement of the name.

plainEnglish.description: User-facing explanatory text shown directly in generated reports. Must be a real, accessible sentence, not the mechanism name restated.

primaryBodySystems.description: Body system IDs this mechanism primarily affects. Resolve display names from body-systems.json at read time; do not store a denormalised name copy here.

guardrail.description: Optional scope-limiting safety note. Populate only for mechanisms that could plausibly be over-read as a medical or hormone-therapy claim (e.g. hormonal/menopausal mechanisms) - not required on every entry.
